notes: Positive: explicit external-research asks (investigate, look up, check changelog, is X a known issue, compare A vs B, RFC quote). Negative: pure repo questions, implementation, design, review, test strategy. Edge: trigger-word 'investiga' on an internal-debug question; comparative analysis that could route to architect; vendor MCP recall vs external research.
